charts.title: HD 63433 d: orbits around HD 63433
charts.description: The orbits of HD 63433's planets in this map from above, to scale, with HD 63433 d highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Capistrant et al. 2024 (2024AJ....167...54C), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname CAPISTRANT_ET_AL_2024): P 4.209075 d

charts.title: HD 63433 d: its transit
charts.description: HD 63433 d crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (46, 47, 72) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 130181866, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, moved 8 minutes earlier to where TESS measures the dip, inside the published ephemeris's 3-sigma uncertainty of 8 minutes at these dates, then averaged in 10-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Aligned on TESS's dip, 8 min early; 10-min bins.
The ephemeris's own 1σ there is 3 min.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
